name: oundnote-library
description: Read meetings from Oundnote on the same computer as Anna Local Agent.

tools.name: library
tools.description: Search meetings and read paginated transcripts or AI notes. Semantic search requires an existing RAG index. Read-only.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Operation to perform on the local meeting library.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search text; required for keywords and semantic.

parameters.name: meeting_id
parameters.description: Positive meeting ID, required for transcript and summary. Omit otherwise.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Use next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

parameters.name: summary_id
parameters.description: AI note version ID. Omit for newest notes; reuse returned id for pagination.
